summary: Petrobras filed a Form 6-K announcing its Board of Directors approved R$17.4 billion in shareholder remuneration, R$1.34814262 per common and preferred share, as an anticipation of FY2026 distributions based on the June 30, 2026 balance sheet. The payment aligns with the company's Shareholder Remuneration Policy, distributing 45% of free cash flow when gross debt is within the strategic plan's maximum. The remuneration is paid in two installments: November 23, 2026 (interest on equity) and December 21, 2026 (mix of dividends and interest on equity), subject to withholding tax and adjusted by the Selic rate. Record dates are August 21, 2026 (B3) and August 25, 2026 (ADR holders), with ADR payments in December. This is a routine capital return event; watch for any policy changes or debt-level shifts affecting future distributions.
